dogs.name: Gordon
dogs.description: Meet Gordon! Gordy came to us during one of the hardest moments of his life. His family, facing heartbreaking circumstances, was told he would be euthanized if surrendered to a local shelter. Desperate to save him, they reached out to rescues — and we said yes. And we are so glad we did. Gordy is young, happy, and full of love. He didn’t deserve to suffer — and despite everything, his gentle heart is still wide open. He’s a sweet, slightly shy boy who has lived peacefully with three small dogs and truly enjoys the company of other pups (he has a soft spot for Chihuahuas!). He’s crate trained, potty trained, and wonderfully well-mannered — the kind of dog who quietly fits into your routine and your heart. Right now, Gordy needs a little extra care. He’s battling severe allergies, a skin infection, and a serious ear infection — one of the toughest we’ve seen. We’re doing everything we can:

dogs.description: Patience Is Her Love Language Katia is the kind of dog who won`t ask for your heart right away—but with a little patience, she`ll quietly earn it. The shelter has been overwhelming for this sweet girl. When you first meet her, she may try to make herself as small as possible while she figures out if the world is safe. But if you give her a little space and let her move at her own pace, you`ll see her courage begin to shine. Once Katia starts to relax, she reveals a smart and gentle side. She`s very treat motivated and already knows `sit,` `shake,` and `down.` She enjoys exploring the yard, and before long, she begins choosing to come over for snacks, gentle pets, and a little human company. Katia is still learning that new people can be trusted, so she`ll do best with an adopter who respects her boundaries and lets the friendship grow naturally. dogs.name: Pippi
dogs.description: THIS IS A COURTESY POST. Please contact Sheryl with OAKDALE TINY PAWS RESCUE, text+1 (209) 606-3640 or email at tinypawsoakdale@gmail.com, Pippi is being fostered in Modesto. Pippi is a 2-year-old Cattle Dog mix with the biggest heart. She is spayed; house trained, knows basic commands, weighs 50 pounds, loves kids, and absolutely loves to cuddle. She gets along well with other dogs, although her playful, high-energy personality can sometimes be a little much for more laid-back pups. She is curious about cats but has done well around them and doesn’t bother them much. Pippi is happiest when she has room to run and something to do. She would thrive on a ranch, farm, or large property with an active family who can give her the time, attention, exercise, and purpose she craves. Our rescue is looking for a forever home where she will be treated like family and loved as much as she deserves.
